lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: do you have a moment to spare?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I've got something important to share.
Sure, what's up?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'm always mistaking

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: towels and dolls for Poli,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: but I've got a towel here

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: that doesn't look like her at all.
Which one?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: The one hanging in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Just like any other ordinary morning,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I got out of bed and stumbled my way into the bathroom.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: But today,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: the towel looked somewhat softer than usual.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I didn't think much of it and just grabbed it.
Don't tell me it was Poli?
Was it a different towel?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Yeah T^T

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: She stepped into the bathroom for a shower a while ago.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I wish!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: It turned out to be Poli (/ ^ \)

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I was positive that it was a towel,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: so I gave it a hard tug.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Sure, Poli said it was fine,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: but I just feel so bad for yanking her hair!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Ugh, I've really done it this time! T^T
C'mon, I'm sure it's not that bad.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: You've no idea how hard I yanked on her hair (/^\)
I mean, you've done things far worse than that before.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: That's true.
Poli's also not one to let little things ruffle her feathers, right?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Rather than needlessly pondering,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I should be working harder to help Poli out.
Yes, that's the spirit!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Then, tugging on Poli's hair

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: and catching her in her birthday suit

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: were just another blunder, all thanks to my poor eyesight.
Wait a second.
If I got that right, I think you owe her an apology.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: ... All right,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'll apologize to her right away.
